NORMAL.action: Leave now via Gate A and walk to Pickup Zone 1, where your parent is waiting.
NORMAL.reason: Your parent is already booked at Pickup Zone 1, so we keep it. The riverside path is busy after the headliner, but it's the shortest and keeps your plan unchanged.
NORMAL.text_localised: Leave now via Gate A and walk to Pickup Zone 1, where your parent is waiting.
NORMAL.reason_localised: Your parent is waiting at Pickup Zone 1, so keep that plan. Gate A is the shortest way, about 9 minutes. Be there by 23:00.

alternatives.action: Take the canopy walk to Gate B and wait at covered Pickup Zone 2.
alternatives.reason: Quieter and covered the whole way, with staff at the zone; the pickup point changes, but Fieldday texts your parent automatically.
alternatives.text_localised: Take the canopy walk to Gate B and wait at covered Pickup Zone 2.

alternatives.action: Walk the lawn path to Gate B and wait at Pickup Zone 2.

alternatives.action: Take the covered ramp path to Gate D and wait at Pickup Zone 3.

STORM.action: Leave now via Gate B on the covered canopy walk to Pickup Zone 2.
STORM.reason: Pickup Zone 1 is closed for the storm. Your parent has been sent the new pickup point automatically. Zone 2 is covered and staffed, and you arrive about 22:43, before 23:00.
STORM.text_localised: Leave now via Gate B on the covered canopy walk to Pickup Zone 2.
STORM.reason_localised: Zone 1 is closed in the storm. Your parent has been texted the new spot. You arrive about 22:43, under cover. Staff there can help.

alternatives.action: Take the covered ramp path to Gate D and wait at Pickup Zone 3.
alternatives.reason: Also covered and staffed, with no steps, but a bit longer (arrive about 22:46) and further from the Lawn Stage.
alternatives.text_localised: Take the covered ramp path to Gate D and wait at Pickup Zone 3.
alternatives.reason_localised: Also covered and staffed, no steps. Slightly longer walk, arrive about 22:46. Your parent is told automatically.

STORM.escalate_text_localised: Go to the nearest info tent or show this screen to any volunteer.
STORM.source: Fieldday Ops · EMP s4.2 Severe weather (MOCK)

GATE_A.action: Leave now via Gate B and wait at Pickup Zone 2 for your parent.
GATE_A.reason: Gate A and Pickup Zone 1 are closed, so pickup moves to Pickup Zone 2 — Fieldday has already texted your parent. This is the shortest walk; it is staffed and covered, and a volunteer will meet you.
GATE_A.text_localised: Leave now via Gate B (Lawn path, 9 min) and wait at Pickup Zone 2 for your parent.
GATE_A.reason_localised: Gate A and Pickup Zone 1 are closed. Your parent has been sent the new pickup point. Zone 2 is covered and staffed; a volunteer will meet you.

alternatives.action: Take the covered canopy walk to Gate B, then Pickup Zone 2.
alternatives.reason: Two minutes longer but covered the whole way if it rains or the lawn path is crowded.
alternatives.text_localised: Take the canopy walk past the food trucks to Gate B, then Pickup Zone 2.
alternatives.reason_localised: Slightly longer but covered all the way. Your parent already has the new pickup point.

alternatives.action: Go out Gate C on the covered path, then walk to Pickup Zone 2.
alternatives.reason: Use if Gate B is too busy; there is an info tent at Gate C, but the last 7 minutes are uncovered.
alternatives.text_localised: If Gate B is too crowded, use the covered path to Gate C, then walk 7 min to Pickup Zone 2.
alternatives.reason_localised: Info tent at Gate C can help you. Last part of the walk is not covered.

alternatives.action: Use Gate D's ramp path and meet your parent at Pickup Zone 3.
alternatives.reason: Quietest, fully covered and staffed route if the other gates feel overwhelming; longer walk.
alternatives.text_localised: Walk the covered ramp path to Gate D and wait at Pickup Zone 3.
alternatives.reason_localised: Quiet, covered and staffed. Longer walk, and your parent must be sent to Zone 3 instead.

GATE_A.escalate_text_localised: Go to the nearest info tent or show this screen to any volunteer.
GATE_A.source: Fieldday Ops · EMP s5.1 Gate closure (MOCK)

TRAIN_SAND_25.action: Leave now via Gate A and meet your parent at Pickup Zone 1.

TRAIN_SAND_25.text_localised: Leave now via Gate A and meet your parent at Pickup Zone 1.
TRAIN_SAND_25.reason_localised: Your pickup is unchanged. Short, flat walk — you should be there about 22:39. The train delay doesn't affect you.

alternatives.action: Go via Gate B's canopy walk to covered Pickup Zone 2.
alternatives.reason: Covered walk and a staffed, covered pickup zone; your parent is sent the new point automatically. Trade-off: steps on the way.
alternatives.text_localised: Take the canopy walk to Gate B, then wait at covered Pickup Zone 2.
alternatives.reason_localised: Covered and staffed. Fieldday has already sent your parent the new pickup point.

alternatives.action: Walk the lawn path to Gate B and wait at Pickup Zone 2.
alternatives.reason: Fastest way to the staffed covered zone, but the path is open-air and has steps.
alternatives.text_localised: Take the lawn path to Gate B, then wait at covered Pickup Zone 2.
alternatives.reason_localised: Quickest route to a staffed covered zone. Your parent is told the new point by SMS.

alternatives.action: Take the covered path to Gate C, then walk to Pickup Zone 2.
alternatives.reason: Use if Gate A or B are too crowded; the last 7 minutes are uncovered.
alternatives.text_localised: Use the covered path to Gate C, then walk 7 minutes to Pickup Zone 2.
alternatives.reason_localised: Good if other gates are crowded. Your parent gets the new pickup point automatically.

TRAIN_SAND_25.escalate_text_localised: Go to the nearest info tent or show this screen to any volunteer.
TRAIN_SAND_25.source: Fieldday Ops · EMP s6.3 Public transport disruption (MOCK)

SHUTTLE_FULL.action: Leave now via Gate A and meet your parent at Pickup Zone 1.

SHUTTLE_FULL.reason_localised: Your plan hasn't changed. Walk the open riverside path to Gate A, then 3 minutes to Pickup Zone 1. You arrive about 22:39.

alternatives.action: Take the canopy walk to Gate B and wait at Pickup Zone 2.
alternatives.reason: Covered walk and a staffed, covered pickup zone, but your pickup point moves; Fieldday texts your parent the new spot automatically.
alternatives.text_localised: Take the canopy walk to Gate B and wait at Pickup Zone 2.
alternatives.reason_localised: Covered path, and Pickup Zone 2 is covered and staffed. Your parent is sent the new pickup point by text automatically.

alternatives.action: Take the lawn path to Gate B and wait at Pickup Zone 2.
alternatives.reason: Quickest way to a staffed pickup zone, but the path is open with steps and the pickup point changes.
alternatives.text_localised: Take the lawn path to Gate B and wait at Pickup Zone 2.
alternatives.reason_localised: Fastest way to a staffed, covered pickup point. Path has steps. Your parent is sent the new pickup point by text.

alternatives.action: Take the covered path to Gate C, then walk to Pickup Zone 2.
alternatives.reason: Use this if Gates A and B are too crowded; it is slower and the last 7 minutes are uncovered.
alternatives.text_localised: Take the covered path to Gate C, then walk 7 minutes to Pickup Zone 2.
alternatives.reason_localised: Use if other gates are crowded. Slower, last part uncovered. Your parent is sent the new pickup point by text.

SHUTTLE_FULL.escalate_text_localised: Go to the nearest info tent or show this screen to any volunteer.
SHUTTLE_FULL.source: Fieldday Ops · EMP s7.4 Accessible transport (MOCK)

alternatives.reason: Fully shaded walk and a covered, staffed pickup zone — best if the heat feels too much. Fieldday has sent your parent the new pickup point.
alternatives.text_localised: Take the shaded canopy walk to Gate B, then wait at covered Pickup Zone 2. Staff are there.
alternatives.reason_localised: Shaded all the way and covered waiting. Your parent has been sent the new pickup point automatically.

alternatives.action: Take the covered path to Gate C, then walk to Pickup Zone 2.
alternatives.reason: Covered inside the site, but 7 open minutes to the pickup zone. Use if Gate A is too crowded.
alternatives.text_localised: Walk the covered path to Gate C, then 7 minutes to covered Pickup Zone 2. Arrive about 22:47.
alternatives.reason_localised: Shade most of the way. Your parent has been sent the new pickup point automatically.

alternatives.action: Take the shaded ramp path to Gate D and wait at Pickup Zone 3.

HEAT.escalate_text_localised: Go to the nearest info tent or show this screen to any volunteer.

SET_RIVER_30.reason_localised: Your parent is waiting at Pickup Zone 1. Short step-free walk, arrive about 22:39. Leave by 23:00.

alternatives.reason: Slightly longer but step-free and fully covered; Zone 3 is also covered and staffed. Use if Gate B steps or crowds are a problem.
alternatives.text_localised: Take the covered ramp path to Gate D, then 4 minutes to Pickup Zone 3. Arrive by 22:46.
alternatives.reason_localised: Also covered and staffed, no steps. Your parent gets the new pickup point by text.
